title: Descendants of Judah and Simeon

questions.question: Who was more honorable than his brothers?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:9 (ESV): "Jabez was more honorable than his brothers..."

questions.question: Why was he named Jabez?
options: Because his mother bore him in pain
Because he was the last born
questions.correctAnswer: Because his mother bore him in pain
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:9 (ESV): "...saying, 'Because I bore him in pain.'"

questions.question: What did Jabez ask God to do?
options: Bless him and enlarge his border
questions.correctAnswer: Bless him and enlarge his border
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:10 (ESV): "...Oh that you would bless me and enlarge my border..."

questions.question: Who was the father of Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:4 (ESV): "...These are the sons of Hur the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem."

questions.question: What craft were the families of the house of Ashbea known for?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:21 (ESV): "...the families of the house of linen workers at Beth-ashbea..."

questions.question: What occupation did the men of Netaim and Gederah have?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:23 (ESV): "These were the potters and inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah..."

questions.question: Who lived in the king’s service?
options: The potters of Netaim and Gederah
questions.correctAnswer: The potters of Netaim and Gederah
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:23 (ESV): "...they lived there in the king's service."

questions.question: How many sons did Shimei have?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:27 (ESV): "Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters..."

questions.question: Where did the descendants of Simeon live until the reign of David?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:28-31 (ESV): Lists the cities including Beersheba. "...These were their cities until David reigned."

questions.question: Who did the Simeonites defeat in the days of Hezekiah?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:41 (ESV): "...attacked their tents and the Meunites who were found there..."

questions.question: Who found the hot springs in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Genesis 36:24 mentions Anah finding hot springs. In 1 Chronicles 4, strict text search doesn't show this. Wait. Checking text... 1 Chron 1:40 mentions Anah. 1 Chron 4 deals with Judah/Simeon. Correction: The "hot springs" story is typically Genesis. Let's check 1 Chron 4 content. 1 Chron 4 lists Othniel. Let's replace.

questions.question: Who was Othniel’s son?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:13 (ESV): "The sons of Othniel: Hathath and Meonothai."

questions.question: Who married Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:17-18 (ESV): "...These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married..."

questions.question: Who were the captains of the Simeonites who went to Mount Seir?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:42 (ESV): "...having as their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel..."

questions.question: Whose remnant did the Simeonites defeat at Mount Seir?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:43 (ESV): "And they defeated the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped..."

questions.question: Who held the lordship in Moab before returning to Bethlehem (Lehem)?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 4:22 (ESV): "...and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab and returned to Lehem..."

key_verse_text: Jabez called upon the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me and enlarge my border, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from harm so that it might not bring me pain!” And God granted what he asked.
